selection: Resolve latest stable once at the start of the local batch from publisher registries/releases, record time/provenance and exact resolved versions, then keep that batch fixed. No nightly/prerelease adoption or downgrade merely because latest points to an older stable line. Existing preview-only source projects use their current documented channel and reviewed immutable commit.

targets.name: typescript
targets.note: Use current native compiler and the publisher-supported current TypeScript 6 compatibility package where existing compiler-API consumers still need it. Resolve that compatibility package from its own registry; distinguish native tsc from API tooling. No fake pass by changing peer ranges or transpiling without typechecking.

sourceProjects.note: Official default source commit, not a stable release claim. Local merge-forward must retain dsh861 features, rules and historical evidence; do not replace the fork wholesale.

requiredCoverage: root and every pnpm workspace dependency/devDependency/optionalDependency/peerDependency/override/catalog and resolved transitive graph
patches and vendored sources, retaining local patches and scope renames
native Cargo manifests/locks and pinned build tools
CI action revisions, Docker/deployment images and other downloaded tool pins actually used by the project
GBrain/PostgreSQL/pgvector only where a concrete installed or deployment declaration exists; absent integration is not an already-upgraded service
completionRule: Every inventory row needs original version, latest resolved target and provenance, resulting version or named incompatibility/absence, changed paths and validation. Metadata lookup alone is not upgrade completion. Refresh transitive versions via supported parent updates, not blanket forced overrides.
localOrder: confirm complete tracked manifest/source inventory and freeze current targets
merge-forward reviewed current upstream source without losing project changes
bootstrap project-local current Node/pnpm and migrate all applicable dependency declarations/patches
regenerate actual locks with the package managers; never hand-edit integrity or retain an obsolete lock while claiming installation
migrate TypeScript compiler/API consumers and binary pin/path consumers
install/frozen reinstall and run affected build/type/lint/behavior/Loader/docs checks; record actual binary identities and no-model configuration compatibility
preserved: all historical versioned receipts/requests/plans and sandbox-tool-bundle.0.149.1.json
